 Safety Guard for ElectroPuls E20000 Test Instrument
 Safety Guard for ElectroPuls E20000 Test Instrument
 Catalog no. 1300-305
1300-305 | Safety Guard for ElectroPuls E20000 Test Instrument
Provides an integrated polycarbonate based guard with a hinged door to prevent operator access to test space when the E20000 is at high power. The guard is also designed to minimize hazards associated with specimen failure.
Includes interlock with ElectroPuls controller to prevent the instrument being switched into high power mode whilst the door is open. Also includes key-switch to over-ride the interlock in extreme cases allowing the machine to operated at high power with the guard door open.
NOTE: Only compatible with 8800MT controller

Accessories for Materials Testing Catalog - Eighth Edition
 Products

 Testing Accessories
»
 Accessories for Materials Testing Catalog
 Accessories for Materials Testing Catalog - Eighth Edition
Welcome to the digital version of our 8th Edition Accessory Catalog, a comprehensive resource featuring hundreds of our latest materials testing accessories. Inside, you’ll find an extensive selection of grips, fixtures, environmental chambers, extensometers, and other specialized tools designed to enhance the performance, accuracy, and versatility of your testing system. This edition also includes practical tips, application insights, and expert guidance to help you get the most out of your equipment and ensure reliable, repeatable results.
As you explore the catalog, please keep in mind that Instron offers extensive engineering and custom design capabilities. If you don’t see an accessory that meets your exact needs, our team is available to discuss your requirements and develop a tailored solution. Many of our products can be modified or engineered to support unique specimen types, challenging test setups, or specialized industry standards.
While certain accessories are designed to fit specific Instron systems as standard, many items can be adapted to work with different Instron models or even equipment from other manufacturers. If you come across a product that interests you but you’re unsure about compatibility, we encourage you to reach out. Our applications and engineering teams are always happy to help you identify the best fit for your testing environment.
Are you a current customer?
This catalog is an essential resource for any lab. It includes the full range of systems and accessories offered by Instron, along with practical guidance on materials testing, grip selection, and choosing the right solutions for your applications.
